title: Coding-tool trial includes verification effort
method: Synthetic equal-scope task. Tool A = 35 implementation + 40 verification minutes; tool B = 50 + 20. Review quality is held constant by the exercise. This is not a comparison of named products.
alt: Coding-tool trial includes verification effort. Tool A total: 75 person-minutes, Tool B total: 70 person-minutes. Illustrative data.
